content:
The e-commerce has evolved a lot in recent years, with an increasingly fluid integration between online and physical stores. In this context, the visual quality of the products plays a central role in offering a consistent and engaging customer experience.

An eBook series that is still relevant

PackshotCreator had the pleasure of collaborating with a free eBook series dedicated to e-commerce photography, alongside experts like Over-Graph, NBS System, 202 Ecommerce, Feed Manager and the Blog Ecommerce agency. This initiative, launched by Jérémy Benmoussa, addressed several topics that are still current:

  • Cross-channel strategies and digitalization of points of sale
  • User experience and the impact of images
  • SEO and visual content management
  • Marketplaces and online advertising (SEA)
  • Customer knowledge and social networks
  • Hosting and security of e-commerce platforms

Even though this series was published a few years ago, its lessons remain essential in the face of new consumer expectations.

Focus on the “UX and Image” eBook

In this book, Laurent Wainberg, founder of PackshotCreator, shares his expertise on advantages of an in-house photo solution For the e-commerce. In it he explains how a automated solution allows:

  • One visual uniformity on all channels (e-commerce site, marketplaces, social networks, points of sale).
  • One cost reduction linked to the production of visuals.
  • One faster upload new products.

faqs.question: Why is the quality of visuals essential in e-commerce?
faqs.answer: The quality of the visuals directly influences the conversion rate and the perception of the brand. Sharp, well-lit, and consistent images allow customers to better appreciate products, reduce return rates, and increase engagement on online sales platforms.

faqs.question: What are the advantages of internalizing the production of product visuals?
faqs.answer: Internalizing product photography allows better control of deadlines and costs, as well as visual consistency across all sales channels. With automated solutions like Orbitvu, it is possible to produce high-quality visuals quickly without advanced technical skills.

faqs.question: How do you optimize product images for SEO?
faqs.answer: To improve image referencing, it is essential to use descriptive file names, relevant ALT tags, and formats adapted to the web (JPEG, WebP). In addition, compressing images without losing quality optimizes page load time, a key factor for SEO and user experience.

faqs.question: What are the current trends in e-commerce photography?
faqs.answer: The rise of 3D, interactive 360° visuals, and artificial intelligence is transforming the way products are presented online. The integration of video and images generated by AI also makes it possible to offer more immersive and engaging experiences.

faqs.question: What is the return on investment (ROI) of an automated photo studio?
faqs.answer: An automated studio significantly reduces the time required to produce visuals, limits human errors and ensures consistent quality. By reducing external costs (photographers, retouching), businesses often see a rapid ROI, especially when they produce a large volume of images for their product catalogs.
